doc.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016

title: Networking through casuals
summary: Casual gigs were the best way to meet players and build a reputation.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: So one thing leads to another out there?

Yeah, yeah. It’s amazing because a lot of the casual work that I did led to — that was the best way to network. Because you would meet new players on each gig and then you would kind of start to build a reputation that is well this guy knows tunes, he can play different kinds of things, he can rock out, so that was really kind of how I built my career initially was through doing these casuals. And wonderful players on the gigs. I mean all the guys and everybody could play.
